name: Japanese Profile
description: Language profile for Japanese literature, light novels, and mystery works.

chapter_rules.pattern: ^\s*第[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百千万]+[話章節編部幕]\s*.*$
chapter_rules.description: Matches numbered Japanese chapters, episodes, or acts

chapter_rules.pattern: ^\s*(序章|プロローグ|エピローグ|終章|幕間|後書き|まえがき)\s*.*$
chapter_rules.description: Matches Japanese prologue, epilogue, interlude, and front/back matter headings
